h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Shahjahanpur

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Shahjahanpur

c: School and college grounds are often the best places for an outdoor gym in a city like Shahjahanpur, on the plains of central Uttar Pradesh. They have the space, a daily stream of users and staff who can keep an eye on the equipment. FunPlay Systems supplies open gym equipment to Shahjahanpur, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,180 km away.

Physical education teachers usually want machines that older students can use safely and that work during a PE period with a full class. Colleges want stations near hostels or sports grounds. Parks and residential colonies want a mix for all ages. We plan each layout around those users, then dispatch by road and install through our team or a dealer in north India. Each machine is inspected at our factory before it is packed and sent by road.

items.q: Are outdoor gym machines suitable for school students?
items.a: They are designed for older students and adults. Younger children should use play equipment instead, and students should be supervised when the gym is used in PE periods.

items.q: How many students can use the gym at once?
items.a: That depends on the number of stations. Double and three-way machines let more students exercise together. We plan the layout around your class sizes.

items.q: What surface should go under the machines?
items.a: A level concrete or paved base, with rubber flooring if you want a softer, non-slip finish. We can supply rubber flooring with the equipment.
